svg.aria-label: Left: reward per episode on the cliff-walking task, averaged over 50 runs and smoothed, for SARSA, Q-learning and Expected SARSA with epsilon 0.1 and step size 0.5. After about 100 episodes Q-learning earns about minus 49 per episode, because it walks along the cliff edge and its exploration sometimes pushes it off, while SARSA earns about minus 26 and Expected SARSA about minus 21. Right: the fraction of runs choosing the action left in state A, against episodes, for Q-learning and double Q-learning; Q-learning chooses the worse action left over 80 percent of the time for the first 50 episodes, double Q-learning drops quickly towards the optimal 5 percent
svg.text: cliff walking: what ε-greedy agents earn while learning
